formula_style_protection_scope.formula_policy: XLSX formulas are exported through cached/data-only cell values when present; formula objects/text are not emitted as Markdown by the old Tk, old PySide6, or current standard XLSX-to-Markdown path.

input.name: cached_formula_probe.xlsx
input.oo_xml_patch: Generated XLSX stores B4 as <f>SUM(B2:B3)</f><v>15</v> so openpyxl data_only=True can read the cached value without requiring an external spreadsheet engine.

cached_formula_probe.comparison_implication: A focused cached-formula XLSX now proves old Tk, old PySide6, and current all render cached/data-only value 15 and do not leak formula text. Broader real workbook batches with formulas remain open for final parity.

formula_style_protection_scope.style_protection_policy: Cell styles, workbook protection, and sheet protection are not represented in the old/current standard Markdown table output; preserving them belongs to spreadsheet format-conversion or a future richer Markdown export, not to current parity for GOLDEN-003.

Old timestamped/source-name PNG and sidecar names and current stable finalizer names are normalized as accepted artifact naming differences; broader real OCR quality and placement matrices remain open.

csv_tsv_scope.remaining_scope: Broader old-system timestamped CSV/TSV output directories are still final-artifact evidence, but CSV/TSV route reachability and current no-preconversion behavior are not open parity gaps.

delimited_block_projection_scope.probe_input: Generated delimited_probe.tsv with two tab-delimited tables separated by one blank row; generated control CSV with the same logical rows.
delimited_block_projection_scope.current_before_fix: The direct TSV route read through pandas with skip_blank_lines=True, collapsed the blank row, reported block_count=1, and rendered the second table header as a data row.
delimited_block_projection_scope.current_fix: packages/plugins/spreadsheet/src/docwen_plugin_spreadsheet/to_markdown/converter.py::_read_csv_flexible now preserves blank rows for .tsv or sniffed tab-delimited input, while keeping CSV blank-row behavior unchanged.
delimited_block_projection_scope.csv_control: Old Tk, old PySide6, and current direct CSV all skip the blank separator in the simple control CSV and produce one Markdown table; no CSV behavior change was required.
delimited_block_projection_scope.remaining_scope: This restores the focused TSV blank-row table-block boundary only. Broader old/current CSV/TSV batches, encoding variants, current-enhancement quoted multiline CSV breadth, and final artifact output-directory projections remain open.
